> Apple Announces New iPad Pros, MacBook Air & Social Media Is Flooded With Hilarious Memes Apple Announces New iPad Pros, MacBook Air & Social Media Is Flooded With Hilarious Memes SAVE
Apple Inc (AAPL.O) refreshed some of its lesser-known products at a New York event. This involved adding iPhone features like facial recognition to the iPad Pro and faster processors and better displays to some Mac computers that had gone years without a major update, reports Reuters.
Reuters
The MacBook Air sees its first significant update since 2015, adding a 13.3-inch retina display with thinner bezels all around, as well as a thinner and lighter body made from 100% recycled aluminium.
The iPad Pro has seen its most significant update since 2015, with a new all-screen display.
The new 11-inch version fits a larger screen in the same sized body as the previous 10.5 inch iPad Pro, while the 12.9-inch version has shrunk in size around the same screen dimensions.
Here's what people had to say about the recent launch and the reactions are hilarious and relatable:
